'''Branimir Jovančićević''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Бранимир Јованчићевић}}; born 15 April 1962) is a Serbian politician who was a member of the [[National Assembly (Serbia)|National Assembly]] from 2022 to 2024. He is also a professor at the Faculty of Chemistry of [[University of Belgrade]].

== Early life ==
Jovančićević was born on 15 April 1962 in [[Užice]], PR Serbia, FPR Yugoslavia. He finished primary and secondary education in his hometown, while he earned his [[doctorate]] at the [[University of Belgrade]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=dr Branimir S. Jovančićević |url=https://www.chem.bg.ac.rs/ |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=Faculty of Chemistry of University of Belgrade |language=sr}}</ref>

== Career ==
Jovančićević has worked at the Faculty of Chemistry of University of Belgrade since 1989. He was promoted to the position of a professor in 2003.<ref name=":0" />

He has been a member of the [[Democratic Party (Serbia)|Democratic Party]] since 2004.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Победнички тим |url=https://ds.org.rs/team |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=ds.org.rs}}</ref> He has been the vice president of DS since 2021.<ref name=":1" />

He took part in the [[2022 Serbian parliamentary election]] on the [[United for the Victory of Serbia]] list and was successfully elected member of the [[National Assembly (Serbia)|National Assembly]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-02-20 |title=Ko su kandidati "Ujedinjeni za pobedu Srbije" za poslanike? |url=https://www.danas.rs/vesti/politika/izbori22/ko-su-kandidati-ujedinjeni-za-pobedu-srbije-za-poslanike/ |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=Danas |language=sr-RS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=prof. dr Branimir Jovančićević |url=http://www.parlament.gov.rs/BRANIMIR_JOVAN%C4%8CI%C4%86EVI%C4%86.1223.891.html |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=National Assembly of Serbia |language=sr}}</ref> His term ended on 6 February 2024 when the [[14th National Assembly of Serbia]] was constituted.<ref>{{Cite web |last=TANJUG |date=2024-02-06 |title=Konstituisan novi saziv Skupštine Srbije, potvrđeni mandati svih poslanika |url=https://www.tanjug.rs/srbija/politika/72405/konstituisan-novi-saziv-skupstine-srbije-potvrdeni-mandati-svih-poslanika/vest |access-date=2024-07-06 |website=tanjug.rs |language=sr-RS}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He is a member of the Serbian Chemistry Society.<ref name=":0" />
